## Resolution

**Disposition: SUPPORTED_RESOLUTION**

For permit NM0028762 (all 17 structured occurrences), `DMR_COMMENT_TEXT = "WHEN DISCHARGING."` encodes permit footnote **\*1 When discharging.** It conditions stated monitoring frequencies — and the associated effluent-limit compliance obligations — on actual discharge occurrence.

**When discharging:** monitoring at the stated frequencies is required and limits apply to the discharge.

**When not discharging:** parameter monitoring is not required; the permittee reports **NO DISCHARGE** on the DMR instead.

|--------|---------|
| `documents/aztec/final_permit.txt` | Intermittent-flow outfall; monitoring marked `(*1)`; footnote `*1 When discharging.`; NO DISCHARGE reporting when no discharge in the month |
| `documents/aztec/statement_of_basis.txt` | Parameters “monitored … when discharging”; backwash is intermittent (once/day to every 3–4 days) |
| `sources/permit_limits.csv` | 17 rows, all NM0028762, `OPTIONAL_MONITORING_FLAG=N` |
| `sources/dmr_measurements.csv` | 140 FY2025 rows: all numeric values, blank NODI — no structured no-discharge signal |

## Remaining limitation

Whether discharge occurred in any specific FY2025 period is a **separate factual question** not answerable from structured data alone, per the relation contract.
